text.WLC: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ עַֽל שׁוֹשַׁנִּ֬ים לְדָוִֽד׃
text.SYN: Начальнику хора. Псалом Давида. В воспоминание.
text.NEO: Au maître de chant. Sur les lys. De David.
text.NAB: For the leader; according to "Lilies." Of David.
text.CEI: Al maestro del coro. Su "I gigli". Di Davide.
text.LXX: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, ὑπὲρ τῶν ἀλλοιωθησομένων· τῷ Δαυείδ.
text.VUL: In finem, pro iis qui commutabuntur. David.
text.DRA: Unto the end, for them that shall be changed; for David.

text.WLC: הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֤י בָ֖אוּ מַ֣יִם עַד נָֽפֶשׁ׃
text.SYN: Поспеши, Боже, избавить меня, _поспеши,_ Господи, на помощь мне.
text.NEO: Sauve-moi, ô Dieu, car les eaux montent jusqu’à mon âme.
text.NAB: Save me, God, for the waters have reached my neck.
text.VAT_ES: ¡Sálvame, Dios mío,
text.CEI: Salvami, o Dio: l'acqua mi giunge alla gola.
text.LXX: Σῶσόν με, ὁ θεός, ὅτι εἰσήλθοσαν ὕδατα ἕως ψυχῆς μου.
text.VUL: Salvum me fac, Deus, quoniam intraverunt aquæ usque ad animam meam.
text.DRA: SAVE me, O God: for the waters are come in even unto my soul.

text.WLC: טָבַ֤עְתִּי בִּיוֵ֣ן מְ֭צוּלָה וְאֵ֣ין מָעֳמָ֑ד בָּ֥אתִי בְמַעֲמַקֵּי מַ֝֗יִם וְשִׁבֹּ֥לֶת שְׁטָפָֽתְנִי׃
text.SYN: Да постыдятся и посрамятся ищущие души моей! Да будут обращены назад и преданы посмеянию желающие мне зла!
text.NEO: Je suis enfoncé dans une fange profonde, et il n’y a pas où poser le pied. Je suis tombé dans un gouffre d’eau, et les flots me submergent.
text.NAB: I have sunk into the mire of the deep, where there is no foothold. I have gone down to the watery depths; the flood overwhelms me.
text.VAT_ES: Estoy hundido en el fango del Abismo
text.CEI: Affondo nel fango e non ho sostegno; sono caduto in acque profonde e l'onda mi travolge.
text.LXX: ἐνεπάγην εἰς ἰλὺν βυθοῦ, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὑπόστασις· ἦλθον εἰς τὰ βάθη τῆς θαλάσσης, καὶ καταιγὶς κατεπόντισέν με.
text.VUL: Infixus sum in limo profundi et non est substantia. Veni in altitudinem maris, et tempestas demersit me.
text.DRA: I stick fast in the mire of the deep: and there is no sure standing. I am come into the depth of the sea: and a tempest hath overwhelmed me.

text.WLC: יָגַ֣עְתִּי בְקָרְאִי֮ נִחַ֪ר גְּר֫וֹנִ֥י כָּל֥וּ עֵינַ֑י מְ֝יַחֵ֗ל לֵאלֹהָֽי׃
text.SYN: Да будут обращены назад за поношение меня говорящие [мне]: "хорошо! хорошо!"
text.NEO: Je m’épuise à crier ; mon gosier est en feu ; mes yeux se consument dans l’attente de mon Dieu.
text.NAB: I am weary with crying out; my throat is parched. My eyes have failed, looking for my God.
text.VAT_ES: Estoy exhausto de tanto gritar,
text.CEI: Sono sfinito dal gridare, riarse sono le mie fauci; i miei occhi si consumano nell'attesa del mio Dio.
text.LXX: ἐκοπίασα κράζων, ἐβραγχίασεν ὁ λάρυγξ μου, ἐξέλιπον οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐγγίζειν ἐπὶ τὸν θεόν μου.
text.VUL: Laboravi clamans, raucæ factæ sunt fauces meæ ; defecerunt oculi mei, dum spero in Deum meum.
text.DRA: I have laboured with crying; my jaws are become hoarse: my eyes have failed, whilst I hope in my God.

text.WLC: רַבּ֤וּ מִשַּׂעֲר֣וֹת רֹאשִׁי֮ שֹׂנְאַ֪י חִ֫נָּ֥ם עָצְמ֣וּ מַ֭צְמִיתַי אֹיְבַ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא גָ֝זַ֗לְתִּי אָ֣ז אָשִֽׁיב׃
text.SYN: Да возрадуются и возвеселятся о Тебе все, ищущие Тебя, и любящие спасение Твое да говорят непрестанно: "велик Бог!"
text.NEO: Ils sont plus nombreux que les cheveux de ma tête, ceux qui me haïssent sans cause ; ils sont puissants ceux qui veulent me perdre, qui sont sans raison mes ennemis. Ce que je n’ai pas dérobé, il faut que je le rende.
text.NAB: More numerous than the hairs of my head are those who hate me without cause. Too many for my strength are my treacherous enemies. Must I now restore what I did not steal?
text.VAT_ES: Más numerosos que los cabellos de mi cabeza
text.CEI: Più numerosi dei capelli del mio capo sono coloro che mi odiano senza ragione. Sono potenti i nemici che mi calunniano: quanto non ho rubato, lo dovrei restituire?
text.LXX: ἐπληθύνθησαν ὑπὲρ τὰς τρίχας τῆς κεφαλῆς μου οἱ μισοῦντές με δωρεάν· ἐκραταιώθησαν οἱ ἐχθροί μου οἱ ἐκδιώκοντές με ἀδίκως· ἃ οὐχ ἥρπασα τότε ἀπετίννυον.
text.VUL: Multiplicati sunt super capillos capitis mei qui oderunt me gratis. Confortati sunt qui persecuti sunt me inimici mei injuste ; quæ non rapui, tunc exsolvebam.
text.DRA: They are multiplied above the hairs of my head, who hate me without cause. My enemies are grown strong who have wrongfully persecuted me: then did I pay that which I took not away.

text.WLC: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ לְאִוַּלְתִּ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁמוֹתַ֗י מִמְּךָ֥ לֹא נִכְחָֽדוּ׃
text.SYN: Я же беден и нищ; Боже, поспеши ко мне! Ты помощь моя и Избавитель мой; Господи! не замедли.
text.NEO: O Dieu, tu connais ma folie, et mes fautes ne te sont pas cachées.
text.NAB: God, you know my folly; my faults are not hidden from you.
text.VAT_ES: Dios mío, tú conoces mi necedad,
text.CEI: Dio, tu conosci la mia stoltezza e le mie colpe non ti sono nascoste.
text.LXX: ὁ θεὸς, σὺ ἔγνως τὴν ἀφροσύνην μου, καὶ αἱ πλημμελίαι μου ἀπὸ σοῦ οὐκ ἐκρύβησαν.
text.VUL: Deus, tu scis insipientiam meam ; et delicta mea a te non sunt abscondita.
text.DRA: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my offences are not hidden from thee:

text.WLC: אַל יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ בִ֨י קֹוֶיךָ֮ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֗ה צְבָ֫א֥וֹת אַל יִכָּ֣לְמוּ בִ֣י מְבַקְשֶׁ֑יךָ אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
text.NEO: Que ceux qui espèrent en toi n’aient pas à rougir à cause de moi, Seigneur, Yahweh des armées ! Que ceux qui te cherchent ne soient pas confondus à mon sujet, Dieu d’Israël !
text.NAB: Let those who wait for you, LORD of hosts, not be shamed through me. Let those who seek you, God of Israel, not be disgraced through me
text.VAT_ES: Que no queden defraudados por mi culpa
text.CEI: Chi spera in te, a causa mia non sia confuso, Signore, Dio degli eserciti; per me non si vergogni chi ti cerca, Dio d'Israele.
text.LXX: μὴ αἰσχυνθείησαν ἐπ’ ἐμοὶ οἱ ὑπομένοντές σε, Κύριε τῶν δυνάμεων· μὴ ἐντραπείησαν ἐπ’ ἐμοὶ οἱ ζητοῦντές σε, ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.
text.VUL: Non erubescant in me qui exspectant te, Domine, Domine virtutum ; non confundantur super me qui quærunt te, Deus Israël.
text.DRA: Let not them be ashamed for me, who look for thee, O Lord, the Lord of hosts. Let them not be confounded on my account, who seek thee, O God of Israel.

text.WLC: כִּֽי עָ֭לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי חֶרְפָּ֑ה כִּסְּתָ֖ה כְלִמָּ֣ה פָנָֽי׃
text.NEO: Car c’est pour toi que je porte l’opprobre, que la honte couvre mon visage.
text.NAB: For your sake I bear insult, shame covers my face.
text.VAT_ES: Por ti he soportado afrentas
text.CEI: Per te io sopporto l'insulto e la vergogna mi copre la faccia;
text.LXX: ὅτι ἕνεκα σοῦ ὑπήνεγκα ὀνειδισμόν, ἐκάλυψεν ἐντροπὴ τὸ πρόσωπόν μου·
text.VUL: Quoniam propter te sustinui opprobrium ; operuit confusio faciem meam.
text.DRA: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

text.WLC: מ֭וּזָר הָיִ֣יתִי לְאֶחָ֑י וְ֝נָכְרִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃
text.NEO: Je suis devenu un étranger pour mes frères, un inconnu pour les fils de ma mère.
text.NAB: I have become an outcast to my kin, a stranger to my mother's children.
text.VAT_ES: me convertí en un extraño para mis hermanos,
text.CEI: sono un estraneo per i miei fratelli, un forestiero per i figli di mia madre.
text.LXX: ἀπηλλοτριωμένος ἐγενήθην τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου, καὶ ξένος τοῖς υἱοῖς τῆς μητρός μου·
text.VUL: Extraneus factus sum fratribus meis, et peregrinus filiis matris meæ.
text.DRA: I am become a stranger to my brethren, and an alien to the sons of my mother.

text.WLC: כִּֽי קִנְאַ֣ת בֵּיתְךָ֣ אֲכָלָ֑תְנִי וְחֶרְפּ֥וֹת ח֝וֹרְפֶ֗יךָ נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽי׃
text.NEO: Car le zèle de ta maison me dévore, et les outrages de ceux qui t’insultent retombent sur moi.
text.NAB: Because zeal for your house consumes me, I am scorned by those who scorn you.
text.VAT_ES: porque el celo de tu Casa me devora,
text.CEI: Poiché mi divora lo zelo per la tua casa, ricadono su di me gli oltraggi di chi ti insulta.
text.LXX: ὅτι ὁ ζῆλος τοῦ οἴκου σου καταφάγεταί με, καὶ οἱ ὀνειδισμοὶ τῶν ὀνειδιζόντων σε ἐπέπεσαν ἐπ’ ἐμέ.
text.VUL: Quoniam zelus domus tuæ comedit me, et opprobria exprobrantium tibi ceciderunt super me.
text.DRA: For the zeal of thy house hath eaten me up: and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

text.WLC: וָאֶבְכֶּ֣ה בַצּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑י וַתְּהִ֖י לַחֲרָפ֣וֹת לִֽי׃
text.NEO: Je verse des larmes et je jeûne : on m’en fait un sujet d’opprobre.
text.NAB: I have wept and fasted, but this led only to scorn.
text.VAT_ES: Cuando aflijo mi alma con ayunos,
text.CEI: Mi sono estenuato nel digiuno ed è stata per me un'infamia.
text.LXX: καὶ συνέκαμψα ἐν νηστίᾳ τὴν ψυχήν μου, καὶ ἐγενήθη εἰς ὀνειδισμὸν ἐμοί·
text.VUL: Et operui in jejunio animam meam, et factum est in opprobrium mihi.
text.DRA: And I covered my soul in fasting: and it was made a reproach to me.

text.WLC: וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה לְבוּשִׁ֣י שָׂ֑ק וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמָשָֽׁל׃
text.NEO: Je prends un sac pour vêtement, et je suis l’objet de leurs sarcasmes.
text.NAB: I clothed myself in sackcloth; I became a byword for them.
text.VAT_ES: cuando me visto de penitente,
text.CEI: Ho indossato come vestito un sacco e sono diventato il loro scherno.
text.LXX: καὶ ἐθέμην τὸ ἔνδυμά μου σάκκον, καὶ ἐγενόμην αὐτοῖς εἰς παραβολήν.
text.VUL: Et posui vestimentum meum cilicium ; et factus sum illis in parabolam.
text.DRA: And I made haircloth my garment: and I became a byword to them.

text.WLC: יָשִׂ֣יחוּ בִ֭י יֹ֣שְׁבֵי שָׁ֑עַר וּ֝נְגִינ֗וֹת שׁוֹתֵ֥י שֵׁכָֽר׃
text.NEO: Ceux qui sont assis à la porte parlent de moi, et les buveurs de liqueurs fortes font sur moi des chansons.
text.NAB: They who sit at the gate gossip about me; drunkards make me the butt of their songs.
text.VAT_ES: los que están a la puerta murmuran contra mí,
text.CEI: Sparlavano di me quanti sedevano alla porta, gli ubriachi mi dileggiavano.
text.LXX: κατ’ ἐμοῦ ἠδολέσχουν οἱ καθήμενοι ἐν πύλῃ, καὶ εἰς ἐμὲ ἔψαλλον οἱ πίνοντες τὸν οἶνον.
text.VUL: Adversum me loquebantur qui sedebant in porta, et in me psallebant qui bibebant vinum.
text.DRA: They that sat in the gate spoke against me: and they that drank wine made me their song.

text.WLC: וַאֲנִ֤י תְפִלָּתִֽי לְךָ֨ יְהוָ֡ה עֵ֤ת רָצ֗וֹן אֱלֹהִ֥ים בְּרָב חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝נֵ֗נִי בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת יִשְׁעֶֽךָ׃
text.NEO: Et moi, je t’adresse ma prière, Yahweh ; dans le temps favorable, ô Dieu, selon ta grande bonté, exauce-moi, selon la vérité de ton salut.
text.NAB: But I pray to you, LORD, for the time of your favor. God, in your great kindness answer me with your constant help.
text.VAT_ES: Pero mi oración sube hasta ti, Señor,
text.CEI: Ma io innalzo a te la mia preghiera, Signore, nel tempo della benevolenza; per la grandezza della tua bontà, rispondimi, per la fedeltà della tua salvezza, o Dio.
text.LXX: ἐγὼ δὲ τῇ προσευχῇ μου πρὸς σέ, Κύριε· καιρὸς εὐδοκίας, ὁ θεός· ἐν τῷ πλήθει τοῦ ἐλέους σου ἐπάκουσον, ἐν ἀληθείᾳ τῆς σωτηρίας σου.
text.VUL: Ego vero orationem meam ad te, Domine ; tempus beneplaciti, Deus. In multitudine misericordiæ tuæ, exaudi me in veritate salutis tuæ.
text.DRA: But as for me, my prayer is to thee, O Lord; for the time of thy good pleasure, O God. In the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

text.WLC: הַצִּילֵ֣נִי מִ֭טִּיט וְאַל אֶטְבָּ֑עָה אִנָּצְלָ֥ה מִ֝שֹּֽׂנְאַ֗י וּמִמַּֽעֲמַקֵּי מָֽיִם׃
text.NEO: Retire-moi de la boue, et que je n’y reste plus enfoncé ; que je sois délivré de mes ennemis et des eaux profondes !
text.NAB: Rescue me from the mire; do not let me sink. Rescue me from my enemies and from the watery depths.
text.VAT_ES: Sácame del lodo para que no me hunda,
text.CEI: Salvami dal fango, che io non affondi, liberami dai miei nemici e dalle acque profonde.
text.LXX: σῶσόν με ἀπὸ πηλοῦ, ἵνα μὴ ἐνπαγῶ· ῥυσθείην ἐκ τῶν μισούντων με καὶ ἐκ τοῦ βάθους τῶν ὑδάτων.
text.VUL: Eripe me de luto, ut non infigar ; libera me ab iis qui oderunt me, et de profundis aquarum.
text.DRA: Draw me out of the mire, that I may not stick fast: deliver me from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

text.WLC: אַל תִּשְׁטְפֵ֤נִי שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת מַ֭יִם וְאַל תִּבְלָעֵ֣נִי מְצוּלָ֑ה וְאַל תֶּאְטַר עָלַ֖י בְּאֵ֣ר פִּֽיהָ׃
text.NEO: Que les flots ne me submergent plus, que l’abîme ne m’engloutisse pas, que la fosse ne se ferme pas sur moi !
text.NAB: Do not let the floodwaters overwhelm me, nor the deep swallow me, nor the mouth of the pit close over me.
text.VAT_ES: que no me arrastre la corriente,
text.CEI: Non mi sommergano i flutti delle acque e il vortice non mi travolga, l'abisso non chiuda su di me la sua bocca.
text.LXX: μή με καταποντισάτω καταιγὶς ὕδατος, μηδὲ καταπιέτω με βυθός, μηδὲ συνσχέτω ἐπ’ ἐμὲ φρέαρ στόμα αὐτοῦ.
text.VUL: Non me demergat tempestas aquæ, neque absorbeat me profundum, neque urgeat super me puteus os suum.
text.DRA: Let not the tempest of water drown me, nor the deep swallow me up: and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

text.WLC: עֲנֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה כִּי ט֣וֹב חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ פְּנֵ֣ה אֵלָֽי׃
text.NEO: Exauce-moi, Yahweh, car ta bonté est compatissante ; dans ta grande miséricorde tourne-toi vers moi,
text.NAB: Answer me, LORD, in your generous love; in your great mercy turn to me.
text.VAT_ES: Respóndeme, Señor, por tu bondad y tu amor,
text.CEI: Rispondimi, Signore, benefica è la tua grazia; volgiti a me nella tua grande tenerezza.
text.LXX: εἰσάκουσόν μου, Κύριε, ὅτι χρηστὸν τὸ ἔλεός σου· κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν οἰκτειρμῶν σου ἐπίβλεψον ἐπ’ ἐμέ·
text.VUL: Exaudi me, Domine, quoniam benigna est misericordia tua ; secundum multitudinem miserationum tuarum respice in me.
text.DRA: Hear me, O Lord, for thy mercy is kind; look upon me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

text.WLC: וְאַל תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵֽעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי צַר לִ֝֗י מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃
text.NEO: Et ne cache pas ta face à ton serviteur ; je suis dans l’angoisse, hâte-toi de m’exaucer.
text.NAB: Do not hide your face from your servant; in my distress hasten to answer me.
text.VAT_ES: no te ocultes el rostro a tu servidor,
text.CEI: Non nascondere il volto al tuo servo, sono in pericolo: presto, rispondimi.
text.LXX: ὅτι θλίβομαι, ταχὺ ἐπάκουσόν μου.
text.VUL: Et ne avertas faciem tuam a puero tuo ; quoniam tribulor, velociter exaudi me.
text.DRA: And turn not away thy face from thy servant: for I am in trouble, hear me speedily.

text.WLC: קָרְבָ֣ה אֶל נַפְשִׁ֣י גְאָלָ֑הּ לְמַ֖עַן אֹיְבַ֣י פְּדֵֽנִי׃
text.NEO: Approche-toi de mon âme, délivre-la ; sauve-moi à cause de mes ennemis.
text.NAB: Come and ransom my life; because of my enemies redeem me.
text.VAT_ES: Acércate a mi y rescátame,
text.CEI: Avvicinati a me, riscattami, salvami dai miei nemici.
text.LXX: πρόσχες τῇ ψυχῇ μου καὶ λύτρωσαι αὐτήν, ἕνεκα τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου ῥῦσαί με.
text.VUL: Intende animæ meæ, et libera eam ; propter inimicos meos, eripe me.
text.DRA: Attend to my soul, and deliver it: save me because of my enemies.

text.WLC: אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִ֣י וּ֭בָשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִ֑י נֶ֝גְדְּךָ֗ כָּל צוֹרְרָֽי׃
text.NEO: Tu connais mon opprobre, ma honte, mon ignominie ; tous mes persécuteurs sont devant toi.
text.NAB: You know my reproach, my shame, my disgrace; before you stand all my foes.
text.VAT_ES: tú conoces mi afrenta, mi vergüenza y mi deshonra,
text.CEI: Tu conosci la mia infamia, la mia vergogna e il mio disonore; davanti a te sono tutti i miei nemici.
text.LXX: σὺ γὰρ γινώσκεις τὸν ὀνειδισμόν μου καὶ τὴν αἰσχύνην μου καὶ τὴν ἐντροπήν μου· ἐναντίον σου πάντες οἱ θλίβοντές με.
text.VUL: Tu scis improperium meum, et confusionem meam, et reverentiam meam ;
text.DRA: Thou knowest my reproach, and my confusion, and my shame.

text.WLC: חֶרְפָּ֤ה שָֽׁבְרָ֥ה לִבִּ֗י וָֽאָ֫נ֥וּשָׁה וָאֲקַוֶּ֣ה לָנ֣וּד וָאַ֑יִן וְ֝לַמְנַחֲמִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א מָצָֽאתִי׃
text.NEO: L’opprobre a brisé mon cœur et je suis malade ; j’attends de la pitié, mais en vain ; des consolateurs, et je n’en trouve aucun.
text.NAB: Insult has broken my heart, and I am weak; I looked for compassion, but there was none, for comforters, but found none.
text.VAT_ES: La vergüenza me destroza el corazón,
text.CEI: L'insulto ha spezzato il mio cuore e vengo meno. Ho atteso compassione, ma invano, consolatori, ma non ne ho trovati.
text.LXX: ὀνειδισμὸν προσεδόκησεν ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ ταλαιπωρίαν· καὶ ὑπέμεινα συνλυπούμενον, καὶ οὐχ ὑπῆρξεν, καὶ παρακαλοῦντα, καὶ οὐχ εὗρον.
text.VUL: in conspectu tuo sunt omnes qui tribulant me. Improperium exspectavit cor meum et miseriam : et sustinui qui simul contristaretur, et non fuit ; et qui consolaretur, et non inveni.
text.DRA: In thy sight are all they that afflict me; my heart hath expected reproach and misery. And I looked for one that would grieve together with me, but there was none: and for one that would comfort me, and I found none.

text.WLC: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ בְּבָרוּתִ֣י רֹ֑אשׁ וְ֝לִצְמָאִ֗י יַשְׁק֥וּנִי חֹֽמֶץ׃
text.NEO: Pour nourriture ils me donnent l’herbe amère ; dans ma soif, ils m’abreuvent de vinaigre.
text.NAB: Instead they put gall in my food; for my thirst they gave me vinegar.
text.VAT_ES: pusieron veneno en mi comida,
text.CEI: Hanno messo nel mio cibo veleno e quando avevo sete mi hanno dato aceto.
text.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκαν εἰς τὸ βρῶμά μου χολήν, καὶ εἰς τὴν δίψαν μου ἐπότισάν με ὄξος.
text.VUL: Et dederunt in escam meam fel, et in siti mea potaverunt me aceto.
text.DRA: And they gave me gall for my food, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

text.WLC: יְהִֽי שֻׁלְחָנָ֣ם לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם לְפָ֑ח וְלִשְׁלוֹמִ֥ים לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃
text.NEO: Que leur table soit pour eux un piège, un filet au sein de leur sécurité !
text.NAB: Make their own table a snare for them, a trap for their friends.
text.VAT_ES: Que su mesa se convierta en una trampa,
text.CEI: La loro tavola sia per essi un laccio, una insidia i loro banchetti.
text.LXX: γενηθήτω ἡ τράπεζα αὐτῶν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν εἰς παγίδα, καὶ εἰς ἀνταπόδοσιν καὶ εἰς σκάνδαλον·
text.VUL: Fiat mensa eorum coram ipsis in laqueum, et in retributiones, et in scandalum.
text.DRA: Let their table become as a snare before them, and a recompense, and a stumblingblock.

text.WLC: תֶּחְשַׁ֣כְנָה עֵ֭ינֵיהֶם מֵרְא֑וֹת וּ֝מָתְנֵ֗יהֶם תָּמִ֥יד הַמְעַֽד׃
text.NEO: Que leurs yeux s’obscurcissent pour ne plus voir ; fais chanceler leurs reins pour toujours.
text.NAB: Make their eyes so dim they cannot see; keep their backs ever feeble.
text.VAT_ES: que se nuble su vista y no vean
text.CEI: Si offuschino i loro occhi, non vedano; sfibra per sempre i loro fianchi.
text.LXX: σκοτισθήτωσαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν τοῦ μὴ βλέπειν, καὶ τὸν νῶτον αὐτῶν διὰ παντὸς σύνκαμψον·
text.VUL: Obscurentur oculi eorum, ne videant, et dorsum eorum semper incurva.
text.DRA: Let their eyes be darkened that they see not; and their back bend thou down always.

text.WLC: שְׁפָךְ עֲלֵיהֶ֥ם זַעְמֶ֑ךָ וַחֲר֥וֹן אַ֝פְּךָ֗ יַשִּׂיגֵֽם׃
text.NEO: Déverse sur eux ta colère, et que le feu de ton courroux les atteigne !
text.NAB: Pour out your wrath upon them; let the fury of your anger overtake them.
text.VAT_ES: Descarga sobe ellos tu indignación,
text.CEI: Riversa su di loro il tuo sdegno, li raggiunga la tua ira ardente.
text.LXX: ἔκχεον ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς τὴν ὀργήν σου, καὶ ὁ θυμὸς τῆς ὀργῆς σου καταλάβοι αὐτούς.
text.VUL: Effunde super eos iram tuam, et furor iræ tuæ comprehendat eos.
text.DRA: Pour out thy indignation upon them: and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

text.WLC: תְּהִי טִֽירָתָ֥ם נְשַׁמָּ֑ה בְּ֝אָהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם אַל יְהִ֥י יֹשֵֽׁב׃
text.NEO: Que leur demeure soit dévastée, qu’il n’y ait plus d’habitants dans leurs tentes !
text.NAB: Make their camp desolate, with none to dwell in their tents.
text.VAT_ES: que sus poblados se queden desiertos
text.CEI: La loro casa sia desolata, senza abitanti la loro tenda;
text.LXX: γενηθήτω ἡ ἔπαυλις αὐτῶν ἠρημωμένη, καὶ ἐν τοῖς σκηνώμασιν αὐτῶν μὴ ἔστω ὁ κατοικῶν·
text.VUL: Fiat habitatio eorum deserta, et in tabernaculis eorum non sit qui inhabitet.
text.DRA: Let their habitation be made desolate: and let there be none to dwell in their tabernacles.

text.WLC: כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר הִכִּ֣יתָ רָדָ֑פוּ וְאֶל מַכְא֖וֹב חֲלָלֶ֣יךָ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃
text.NEO: Car ils persécutent celui que tu frappes, ils racontent les souffrances de celui que tu blesses.
text.NAB: For they pursued the one you struck, added to the pain of the one you wounded.
text.VAT_ES: Porque persiguen al que tú has castigado
text.CEI: perché inseguono colui che hai percosso, aggiungono dolore a chi tu hai ferito.
text.LXX: ὅτι ὃν σὺ ἐπάταξας αὐτοὶ κατεδίωξαν, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄλγος τῶν τραυμάτων μου προσέθηκαν.
text.VUL: Quoniam quem tu percussisti persecuti sunt, et super dolorem vulnerum meorum addiderunt.
text.DRA: Because they have persecuted him whom thou hast smitten; and they have added to the grief of my wounds.

text.WLC: תְּֽנָה עָ֭וֺן עַל עֲוֺנָ֑ם וְאַל יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּצִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃
text.NEO: Ajoute l’iniquité à leur iniquité, et qu’ils n’aient pas part à ta justice.
text.NAB: Add that to their crimes; let them not attain to your reward.
text.VAT_ES: Impútales una culpa tras otra,
text.CEI: Imputa loro colpa su colpa e non ottengano la tua giustizia.
text.LXX: πρόσθες ἀνομίαν ἐπὶ τὴν ἀνομίαν αὐτῶν, καὶ μὴ εἰσελθέτωσαν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ σου·
text.VUL: Appone iniquitatem super iniquitatem eorum, et non intrent in justitiam tuam.
text.DRA: Add thou iniquity upon their iniquity: and let them not come into thy justice.

text.WLC: יִ֭מָּחֽוּ מִסֵּ֣פֶר חַיִּ֑ים וְעִ֥ם צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים אַל יִכָּתֵֽבוּ׃
text.NEO: Qu’ils soient effacés du livre de vie et qu’ils ne soient pas inscrits avec les justes.
text.NAB: Strike them from the book of the living; do not count them among the just!
text.VAT_ES: bórralos del Libro de la Vida,
text.CEI: Siano cancellati dal libro dei viventi e tra i giusti non siano iscritti.
text.LXX: ἐξαλειφθήτωσαν ἐκ βίβλου ζώντων, καὶ μετὰ δικαίων μὴ γραφήτωσαν.
text.VUL: Deleantur de libro viventium, et cum justis non scribantur.
text.DRA: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living; and with the just let them not be written.

text.WLC: וַ֭אֲנִי עָנִ֣י וְכוֹאֵ֑ב יְשׁוּעָתְךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים תְּשַׂגְּבֵֽנִי׃
text.NEO: Moi, je suis malheureux et souffrant ; que ton secours, ô Dieu, me relève !
text.NAB: But I am afflicted and in pain; let your saving help protect me, God,
text.VAT_ES: Yo soy un pobre desdichado, Dios mío,
text.CEI: Io sono infelice e sofferente; la tua salvezza, Dio, mi ponga al sicuro.
text.LXX: πτωχὸς καὶ ἀλγῶν εἰμι ἐγώ, καὶ ἡ σωτηρία τοῦ προσώπου σου ἀντελάβετό μου.
text.VUL: Ego sum pauper et dolens ; salus tua, Deus, suscepit me.
text.DRA: But I am poor and sorrowful: thy salvation, O God, hath set me up.

text.WLC: אֲהַֽלְלָ֣ה שֵׁם אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּשִׁ֑יר וַאֲגַדְּלֶ֥נּוּ בְתוֹדָֽה׃
text.NEO: Je célébrerai le nom de Dieu par des cantiques, je l’exalterai par des actions de grâces ;
text.NAB: That I may praise God's name in song and glorify it with thanksgiving.
text.VAT_ES: así alabaré con cantos el nombre de Dios,
text.CEI: Loderò il nome di Dio con il canto, lo esalterò con azioni di grazie,
text.LXX: αἰνέσω τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θεοῦ μετ’ ᾠδῆς, μεγαλυνῶ αὐτὸν ἐν αἰνέσει,
text.VUL: Laudabo nomen Dei cum cantico, et magnificabo eum in laude :
text.DRA: I will praise the name of God with a canticle: and I will magnify him with praise.

text.WLC: וְתִיטַ֣ב לַֽ֭יהוָה מִשּׁ֥וֹר פָּ֗ר מַקְרִ֥ן מַפְרִֽיס׃
text.NEO: Et Yahweh les aura pour plus agréables qu’un taureau, qu’un jeune taureau avec cornes et sabots.
text.NAB: My song will please the LORD more than oxen, more than bullocks with horns and hooves:
text.VAT_ES: esto agradará al Señor más que un toro,
text.CEI: che il Signore gradirà più dei tori, più dei giovenchi con corna e unghie.
text.LXX: καὶ ἀρέσει τῷ θεῷ ὑπὲρ μόσχον νέον κέρατα ἐκφέροντα καὶ ὁπλάς.
text.VUL: et placebit Deo super vitulum novellum, cornua producentem et ungulas.
text.DRA: And it shall please God better than a young calf, that bringeth forth horns and hoofs.

text.WLC: רָא֣וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים יִשְׂמָ֑חוּ דֹּרְשֵׁ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וִיחִ֥י לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
text.NEO: Les malheureux, en le voyant, se réjouiront, et vous qui cherchez Dieu, votre cœur revivra.
text.NAB: "See, you lowly ones, and be glad; you who seek God, take heart!
text.VAT_ES: Que lo vean los humildes y se alegren,
text.CEI: Vedano gli umili e si rallegrino; si ravvivi il cuore di chi cerca Dio,
text.LXX: ἰδέτωσαν πτωχοὶ καὶ εὐφρανθήτωσαν, ἐκζητήσατε τὸν θεὸν καὶ ζήσεσθε.
text.VUL: Videant pauperes, et lætentur ; quærite Deum, et vivet anima vestra :
text.DRA: Let the poor see and rejoice: seek ye God, and your soul shall live.

text.WLC: כִּֽי שֹׁמֵ֣עַ אֶל אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶת אֲ֝סִירָ֗יו לֹ֣א בָזָֽה׃
text.NEO: Car Yahweh écoute les pauvres, et il ne méprise pas ses captifs.
text.NAB: For the LORD hears the poor, does not spurn those in bondage.
text.VAT_ES: porque el Señor escucha a los pobres
text.CEI: poiché il Signore ascolta i poveri e non disprezza i suoi che sono prigionieri.
text.LXX: ὅτι εἰσήκουσεν τῶν πενήτων ὁ κύριος, καὶ τοὺς πεπεδημένους αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐξουδένωσεν.
text.VUL: quoniam exaudivit pauperes Dominus, et vinctos suos non despexit.
text.DRA: For the Lord hath heard the poor: and hath not despised his prisoners.

text.WLC: יְֽ֭הַלְלוּהוּ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֑רֶץ יַ֝מִּ֗ים וְֽכָל רֹמֵ֥שׂ בָּֽם׃
text.NEO: Que les cieux et la terre le célèbrent, les mers et tout ce qui s’y meut !
text.NAB: Let the heavens and the earth sing praise, the seas and whatever moves in them!"
text.VAT_ES: Que lo alaben el cielo, la tierra y el mar,
text.CEI: A lui acclamino i cieli e la terra, i mari e quanto in essi si muove.
text.LXX: αἰνεσάτωσαν αὐτὸν οἱ οὐρανοὶ καὶ ἡ γῆ, θάλασσα καὶ πάντα τὰ ἕρποντα ἐν αὐτοῖς.
text.VUL: Laudent illum cæli et terra ; mare, et omnia reptilia in eis.
text.DRA: Let the heavens and the earth praise him; the sea, and every thing that creepeth therein.

text.WLC: כִּ֤י אֱלֹהִ֨ים י֘וֹשִׁ֤יעַ צִיּ֗וֹן וְ֭יִבְנֶה עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וְיָ֥שְׁבוּ שָׁ֝֗ם וִירֵשֽׁוּהָ׃
text.NEO: Car Dieu sauvera Sion et bâtira les villes de Juda, on s’y établira et l’on en prendra possession ;
text.NAB: God will rescue Zion, rebuild the cities of Judah. God's servants shall dwell in the land and possess it;
text.VAT_ES: porque Dios salvará a Sión
text.CEI: Perché Dio salverà Sion, ricostruirà le città di Giuda: vi abiteranno e ne avranno il possesso.
text.VUL: Quoniam Deus salvam faciet Sion, et ædificabuntur civitates Juda, et inhabitabunt ibi, et hæreditate acquirent eam.
text.DRA: For God will save Sion, and the cities of Juda shall be built up. And they shall dwell there, and acquire it by inheritance.

text.VUL: Et semen servorum ejus possidebit eam ; et qui diligunt nomen ejus habitabunt in ea.
text.DRA: And the seed of his servants shall possess it; and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
